description:
V00.75 REST/SSE bridge over the Security Event Bus core. Provides
    GET /api/events/stream (server-sent events with Last-Event-ID
    resume) and POST /api/events for external producers that submit
    signed envelopes. Reuses jSentinel-rest's authorization filter;
    the Consume-Pipeline from jSentinel-events runs end-to-end on
    every accepted envelope.
